title: Controlled rollout blast radius
snippet: A staged release limits the number of affected users while deployment assumptions are still being tested.

title: Rollback ownership record
snippet: A rollout is reversible only when rollback criteria, an authorized owner, and a tested recovery action are defined before traffic expands.

title: Expansion gate checklist
snippet: Traffic expansion requires monitored error rate, tail latency, and user-impact signals rather than a time-only gate.

title: Approximate index recall note
snippet: The approximate index loses some hard-neighbor recall at the tested search depth, while exact search retains all labeled neighbors.

title: Index latency and memory profile
snippet: The graph index reduces query latency but consumes more resident memory than the compressed inverted index on the fixture workload.

title: Index update behavior
snippet: Frequent document updates cause rebuild work for the compressed index, while the graph index accepts incremental inserts with temporary fragmentation.

title: Dense retrieval coverage
snippet: Dense retrieval recovers paraphrased relevant passages that lexical retrieval misses in the controlled query set.

title: Reranker ordering audit
snippet: A cross-encoder moves labeled supporting passages above topically similar distractors after candidate retrieval.

title: Reranker latency budget
snippet: Reranking every candidate exceeds the interactive latency allowance; limiting reranking to the retrieved shortlist stays within the allowance.

title: Memory retrieval audit
snippet: Unfiltered long-term memory injects unrelated preferences into later tasks, while scoped retrieval reduces irrelevant context.

title: Memory privacy requirement
snippet: Sensitive user facts require explicit retention scope, deletion support, and isolation between users before persistent memory is enabled.

title: Stale memory incident
snippet: An expired deployment preference overrode a newer instruction because the memory record lacked freshness and conflict metadata.

title: Independent branch timing study
snippet: Independent source-review branches completed faster in parallel because they shared no intermediate dependency.

title: Delegation coordination log
snippet: Delegation added prompt, merge, and duplicate-search overhead even when every branch returned successfully.

title: Dependent branch counterexample
snippet: Parallelizing dependent analysis caused rework because downstream branches ran before upstream evidence was available.

title: Checkpoint recovery drill
snippet: A persisted checkpoint allowed the workflow to resume from the last verified stage instead of replaying the entire run.

title: Side-effect replay incident
snippet: Recovery repeated an external write because the checkpoint stored state but not the side-effect idempotency key.

title: Checkpoint storage profile
snippet: Very frequent full snapshots increased storage writes and run latency compared with periodic snapshots plus an event log.

title: Sparse checkpoint counterexample
snippet: Sparse checkpoints reduced steady-state overhead but forced substantial recomputation after a late-stage failure.

title: Model routing quality gate
snippet: Simple extraction tasks met the quality rubric on the smaller route, while multi-source synthesis required the stronger route.

title: Routing latency profile
snippet: Sending every request to the strongest route increased queue time for tasks that did not need its capability.

title: Routing data policy
snippet: Requests containing restricted fields may use only endpoints approved for that data class, regardless of quality or price.

title: Duplicate routing summary
snippet: A summary repeats that easy tasks can use a smaller model and complex tasks can use a stronger model but provides no new evaluation condition.

title: Transient retry outcome
snippet: A bounded retry recovers intermittent transport failures when attempts use exponential backoff and a maximum deadline.

title: Non-idempotent retry warning
snippet: Automatically retrying a non-idempotent action can duplicate side effects unless the tool accepts an idempotency key.

title: Retry tail-latency profile
snippet: Multiple retries improve completion for transient errors but extend tail latency and can consume the remaining run budget.

title: Retry guidance duplicate
snippet: The duplicate note recommends retries for temporary failures without specifying safety, backoff, or stopping conditions.

title: Compaction token profile
snippet: Summarizing completed branches reduces repeated prompt tokens in later model calls.

title: Compaction fact-loss audit
snippet: A free-form summary dropped a minority constraint that later changed the recommended decision.

title: Durable context comparison
snippet: Keeping structured decisions and evidence references outside the conversational summary preserves audit-critical facts during compaction.

title: Evaluation task taxonomy
snippet: An evaluation set must cover representative workflows and named failure modes rather than sample only convenient successful tasks.

title: Judge agreement audit
snippet: The automated judge disagrees with expert labels on claim strength, so a human-calibrated subset and agreement report are required.

title: Evaluation cost allocation
snippet: Under a fixed evaluation budget, deterministic checks should cover structural failures and scarce human review should target semantic support and difficult cases.
